data_fields.name: crossfade time per clip switch
data_fields.donor_constant: no donor default; caller argument afFadeTime (weight rate 1/|t|)

best_idea: Switch a creature's clip by fading the new one in from weight 0 over a fixed time while the old one fades out, and drive the clip's playback rate from the creature's move speed with a small dead zone and a turn-speed fallback.
decision_why: The fade switch and the move-speed-to-clip-rate rule fit creature locomotion, but Frankendom blends with a normalised mean rather than the donor's order-dependent product (weights are not normalised in the donor), clamps the fade time in the catalogue, and keeps clip-end events out of fight state.
acceptance: A player sees an idle-to-chase switch fade over the catalogue fade time with no pop, and the chase clip plays at the move speed scaled by the creature's catalogue multiplier, dropping to the turn-speed fallback below the dead zone; a server test asserts that no clip event changes an attack, stagger or death state.
